text: Candidates must possess a minimum of a bachelor's degree in a relevant field and at least two years of professional experience. Applications missing mandatory educational certificates will be automatically rejected. Candidates who have applied within the last six months are not eligible to reapply for the same role.

Once shortlisted, candidates will receive an automated email containing a calendar link to select a preferred interview slot. Interviews must be scheduled within 5 business days of receiving the link. If a candidate needs to reschedule, they must provide at least 24 hours of notice.

The company offers competitive salaries based on market benchmarks and internal parity. Candidates may request a salary review within 3 days of receiving the initial offer letter. Any revised offer requires secondary approval from the Department Head and the HR Director.

All offers are contingent upon the successful completion of a comprehensive background check. This includes criminal records, employment history, and educational degree verification. The background verification process typically takes between 7 to 14 business days.

The standard notice period for all confirmed employees is 60 days. In exceptional cases, a notice period buyout may be approved by the Department Head. Employees on probation have a reduced notice period of 15 days.

Employees who refer a candidate successfully hired for a full-time role will receive a referral bonus. The bonus is paid out only after the referred employee completes their probation period. Executives and HR staff directly involved in the hiring decision are not eligible for this bonus.

Employees must complete at least 18 months in their current role before applying for an internal transfer. A performance rating of 'Exceeds Expectations' or 'Meets Expectations' in the most recent appraisal is required. The current manager must be informed before the formal internal interview process begins.

All new hires are subject to a standard probation period of 6 months. During this time, performance will be evaluated at the 3-month and 5-month marks. The company reserves the right to extend the probation period or terminate employment if performance expectations are not met.

Remote work is available for roles designated as 'hybrid' or 'fully remote' in the job description. Hybrid employees are expected to be in the office at least 3 days a week. Fully remote employees must maintain core working hours overlapping with the standard Indian Standard Time (IST) business day.

The company is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse workforce. Interview panels must include diverse representatives to mitigate unconscious bias. We actively partner with organizations that support underrepresented groups in technology and corporate sectors.

An exit interview is mandatory for all departing employees to gather feedback on their experience. The HR department will schedule this interview during the employee's final week of notice. Insights from exit interviews are anonymized and used to improve retention strategies.

Candidate data, including resumes and interview notes, is securely retained for a period of 12 months after the hiring process concludes. This allows us to contact candidates for future opportunities. After 12 months, all personal data is permanently deleted from our systems unless the candidate provides explicit consent to extend retention.
